1	What is 7 Free Nail Polish? And Why is 10 Free Even Better!
     2	September 27, 2021 By Mary Lennon
     3	
     4	Did you know that the nail polish you are currently using could be affecting your health in ways you
     5	may have never even thought? 
     6	Mainstream nail polishes contain several chemicals and other harsh ingredients that have the ability
     7	to cause severe adverse reactions alongside damaging health concerns. 
     8	As a result of this, you may have come across nail polish brands that claim to be 3-free, 5-free, or
     9	even 7-free, and it is likely that you have wondered what exactly is meant by those confusing
    10	phrases.  
    11	In this blog post, we will be covering everything that you need to know about non-toxic nail
    12	polish, as well as offer an explanation as to why the nail polish you are using right now could be
    13	bad for your health.
    14	
    15	
    16	
    17	**The Importance Of Non-Toxic Nail Polish**
    18	First off, to truly understand the importance of non-toxic nail polish, it is fundamental that one
    19	knows the negative health connotations associated with regular nail polish.
    20	A 2015 study found that certain chemicals that are used in most bottles of nail polish, can be
    21	absorbed into the body via the nails and cause several damaging health effects to the user. 
    22	These damaged health effects vary greatly from person to person, but they can cause quite a
    23	devastating impact. Regular types of nail polish contain cancer-causing chemicals, can cause hormone
    24	imbalances, alongside thyroid issues, and increase the risk of diabetes should you be overexposing
    25	yourself to the product. 
    26	Though you may assume that you are not going to be affected by these chemicals, just think of how
    27	much you breathe in the scent of nail lacquer while painting your nails and how often the paint
    28	touches your skin, as well as the amount of contact your nails have with your mouth directly, or
    29	when preparing food for both you and your loved ones.   
    30	Fortunately, enough research has been established so that while regular nail polish used at your
    31	nail salon is sadly still able to promote itself, innovative and safe nail products have been
    32	developed with the health of the customer in mind.
    33	Non- toxic nail polish comes in several variants, with each type excluding certain chemicals,
    34	ingredients, and products that may have highly damaging effects on the user. These types of non
    35	toxic nail polishes are often referred to as 3-free, 5-free, 7-free, or 10-free. 
    36	Here at Côte Nail Polish, all of our vegan nail polishes are cruelty-free, and most importantly,
    37	non-toxic. Our customers can be assured that their health is our optimal concern and that we will
    38	always endeavor to use the best and highest quality ingredients for our nail polish and
    39	accessories. 
    40	
    41	**What Is 7-Free Nail Polish?**
    42	7-free nail polish is free of 7 toxic chemicals that are common in most regular nail polish
    43	formulas. The chemicals this nail lacquer is free from are as follows: dibutyl phthalate,
    44	formaldehyde, toluene, formaldehyde resin, camphor, ethyl tosylamide, and xylene.
    45	Each of these chemicals can have a negative impact on the user’s health, and therefore, substituting
    46	them out of the polish formula will help to lessen the toxic effect of nail varnish. 
    47	There are also other variants of the free toxin nail polish, each omitting a specific number of
    48	chemicals:
    49	3-Free:
    50	This formula is void of the “Toxic Trio”: Dibutyl Phthalate (DPB), Formaldehyde, and Toluene. These
    51	three chemicals are by far the most harmful, as they are associated with some of the most harmful
    52	and debilitating diseases, including cancer and diabetes. 
    53	5-Free: 
    54	The chemicals excluded in 5- free include the above-mentioned “Toxic Trio” as well as formaldehyde
    55	resin, and camphor. 
    56	10-Free: 
    57	This type of formula omits dibutyl phthalate, TPHP, toluene, xylene, ethyl tosylamide, camphor,
    58	formaldehyde, formaldehyde resin, parabens, and gluten. Therefore, this formula of nail polish is
    59	considered to be one of the safest types of nail polish due to its substitution of toxic chemicals. 
    60	
    61	
    62	**Chemicals Excluded in 7-Free Polish**
    63	Simply providing the names of the seven harmful chemicals left out of these 7- free polishes will
    64	not accurately represent the harm that these toxins can cause. In this section, we have outlined the
    65	chemicals that are excluded from seven free nail polishes, explaining the health issues that these
    66	can cause. 
    67	Dibutyl Phthalate (DPB): 
    68	DPB is a harsh chemical that affects the endocrine system, which controls hormone regulation. Too
    69	much DPB can cause issues with your thyroid, causing mental health issues as well as physical
    70	problems like fatigue. It can also hamper developmental growth and potentially affect reproductive
    71	health.
    72	Formaldehyde:
    73	This commonly used chemical is a known human carcinogen, meaning it has been known to increase the
    74	risk of cancer. It can also cause severe dermatitis, skin irritation, and eye irritation. 
    75	Toluene:
    76	Toluene can cause birth defects in the children of pregnant women who are overly exposed to the
    77	chemical. It can also affect the nervous system, causing nausea, lightheadedness, and fatigue.  
    78	Formaldehyde Resin: 
    79	This chemical is a common allergen causing skin irritation, redness, and itching. It is used in
    80	nail lacquers to help solidify the liquid into a thicker texture. 
    81	Camphor: 
    82	Camphor can lead to poor nail health, which is the opposite of what you want when caring for and
    83	painting your nails. This is because the harsh toxins strip your nails of their essential nutrients,
    84	starving them of what they need to maintain their strength. This chemical can also cause
    85	disorientation, and more alarmingly, seizures. 
    86	Ethyl Tosylamide:
    87	This chemical is banned in Europe due to potentially causing severe allergic reactions in users. The
    88	role of Ethyl Tosylamide is to help the polish to stick to the surface of the nail, though non-toxic
    89	nail polish also has great durability without the associated health risks. 
    90	Xylene:
    91	This chemical is what gives your nail polish that distinct smell that often causes headaches or
    92	lightheadedness. It is used in nail polish to avoid clumpiness by thinning out the solution, but it
    93	is an incredibly toxic chemical that can cause immense reactions and irritation. 
    94	
    95	**Why 10-Free Nail Polish Is Even Better**
    96	10-free nail polish is better than 7-free as it excludes some additional chemicals and products that
    97	are not only toxic but also environmentally damaging, and even unethical to be using.  
    98	
    99	Parabens: 
   100	Parabens are a group of preservatives that are used in polishes to aid longevity. Not only do
   101	parabens interfere with the hormonal system, but they're also a factor directly involved with
   102	well-researched carcinogens that can cause skin and breast cancer.  
   103	Triphenyl Phosphate:
   104	Triphenyl phosphate is another harmful toxin often included in traditional nail polish to aid the
   105	malleability of the varnish. Ongoing or frequent or extended exposure to Triphenyl phosphate can
   106	cause changes in hormone regulation, affecting reproductive systems, as well as metabolism.
   107	Consequently, it is best to avoid this harmful chemical, especially in your nail polish.

   110	gluten in their nail polish can lead to severe adverse reactions. For those with celiac disease,
   111	topical exposure to wheat products can cause irritation. 
   112	
   113	
   114	**Conclusion**
   115	In summary, regular nail polishes can be extremely harmful to not only the health of your nails but
   116	to your body as a whole! We believe that educating people on the toxic ingredients in nail polish
   117	can help customers to make more informed decisions regarding their health.
   118	At Côte, we are dedicated to sharing our belief in beautiful, clean, and safe nontoxic nail
   119	polishes, and that is why all our products are 10- free, cruelty free, with a non-toxic formula and
   120	amazing vibrant colors. Additionally, all of our products are vegan and free of studies involving

According to `doc.txt`, a 10-free nail polish is a formula that omits ten chemicals and products: dibutyl phthalate, TPHP (triphenyl phosphate), toluene, xylene, ethyl tosylamide, camphor, formaldehyde, formaldehyde resin, parabens, and gluten.

The document adds that:

- Because it substitutes out these toxic chemicals, this formula is considered one of the safest types of nail polish.
- It is "even better" than 7-free polish because it excludes additional chemicals and products that are not only toxic but also environmentally damaging and unethical to use.
- The three extras beyond the 7-free list are:
  - **Parabens** – preservatives used to aid longevity that interfere with the hormonal system and are linked to well-researched carcinogens that can cause skin and breast cancer.
  - **Triphenyl phosphate (TPHP)** – a toxin used to aid the malleability of the varnish; ongoing or extended exposure can cause changes in hormone regulation, affecting reproductive systems and metabolism.
  - **Gluten** – which for those with a gluten allergy or intolerance can lead to severe adverse reactions, and for those with celiac disease, topical exposure to wheat products can cause irritation.
